Maria: quick ping — opened PR to onboard gpt-small-v2 with a tokenizer normalization tweak and a new serving profile. can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/8123 :eyes:
Jake: looking now, is this only NFKC normalization or any token mapping changes?
Maria: NFKC + one small mapping: we now treat U+2019 as ASCII apostrophe in tokenization table (see diff). also bumped default max_seq to 2048 in profile.
Anika: fyi that apostrophe mapping can affect legacy prompts where smart quotes were intentionally preserved. did you rerun the prompt-preservation eval?
Maria: yes — ran the prompt-preservation suite on 5k examples. diffs are ~0.2% on exact-match; semantic sims unchanged. pushed results to the PR checks.
Sean: can you paste the profile snippet? quick scan for batch/kv cache sizes.
Maria: sure:
```yaml
model_profile:
  name: gpt-small-v2
  max_seq: 2048
  kv_cache_bytes: 512MB
  preferred_batch_size: [1,4,8,16]
  quantization: int8_static
```
Jake: kv_cache_bytes looks fine. did you bench latency with the new quantization profile?
Maria: yes — 99th p90 token-latency went from 18ms -> 19.5ms on p4d with int8_static, throughput improved ~12%. results linked in PR.
Priya: I can review tokenization code and the tests in ~30m. leave a TODO for docs update? we should mention the apostrophe normalization in the migration notes.
Maria: good call — added a migration note in docs/upgrade.md in the same PR.
ci-bot: PR 8123 — unit tests: failed on tokenizer/edge_cases.py: test_smart_quotes (see logs)
Maria: thanks ci-bot, saw that. fixed edge case for double-smart-quote sequences and pushed a hotfix.
ci-bot: PR 8123 — unit tests: all checks passed 
Jake: gave an approval on the tokenizer change. :thumbsup:
Anika: left a comment about adding a tiny eval to cover deliberate smart-quote preservation (opt-in flag). not blocking.
Priya: LGTM on the code side. one nit about a doc wording but not blocking.
Sean: quick ops question — merging this will add a new model variant to model-catalog. any rollout plan? can we canary 10% traffic?
Maria: yes — plan is canary on dedicated for 24h at 10% traffic, monitor latency/cost in console, auto-fallback to gpt-small-v1 on QoS violation. added rollout config in the PR.
Jake: can you add a tracing hook for the tokenizer so we can see tokenization anomalies in traces?
Maria: added a lightweight trace event: tokenization.variant and tokenization.mappings in trace payload (low-cardinality).
Sean: great. once Priya merges, I'll schedule the canary and keep an eye on the dashboards.
Maria: thanks all — merging now. if anything weird, ping #eng-oncall and I'll roll back. :rocket:
